text:
There was a big, red sign saying the shop was open, and Google Maps also said it was open. But when I got there, the woman inside said the shop was closed and the doctor wasn't there.
As I left, I turned back and saw another small sign saying the doctor wasn't there. I understand I didn't read that small sign before entering, and I accept that as my fault. But shouldn't I trust reliable sources like Google? The website said it was open, and the shop itself also said it was open. Wouldn't patients be confused? The shop opens at 5 PM, and traffic is terrible. I was in a hurry because I was sick with a rash. It was a terrible first time seeing a dermatologist. I lost work and had to pay for a Grab ride. A complete waste of money and time. 21/01/2026

I've had acne treated here before, and my sister also had acne treated here.
In the end, neither of us got cured. But the doctor spoke in a confident, blunt way, saying it was a permanent cure, that treatment only took 5 months, costing 7500+ baht, and was more worthwhile than having acne for life, blah blah blah.
The doctor was egocentric and didn't listen to what the patient was really trying to communicate. The doctor just said what they believed was right and didn't care.

- The doctor gave me information in a perfunctory manner and spoke abruptly.
- The acne medication doesn't seem to be working.
I had severe skin peeling for several months. After taking the doctor's medication for 7 days, it cleared up completely! It was amazing.

The doctor is excellent. The care is great, and they don't prolong treatment unnecessarily. I had acne for 18 years without success, but after 4 months of treatment, my acne completely disappeared and hasn't returned. They don't prolong treatment unnecessarily, and the price isn't expensive. The doctor is very dedicated. I'm currently still being treated for my melasma.
Acne scar cream with a blue cap. It really works, but it takes time. The dark spots start to fade from the first month.

The doctor spoke bluntly and in a way that was not pleasant to listen to. He was too busy watching TV and not paying attention to the patient. I came to see the doctor because I wanted to get better and get advice, not because the doctor would just talk to me in a perfunctory manner.
I've been here for acne consultations, but the doctor and service were not very good.
It works well, I'd like to buy more.
